tokyo_hibiya_matsumotoro.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the 1F grill serves curry (European-style roux), omurice, hamburg, fried shrimp, crab cream croquettes and cakes.
tokyo_hibiya_matsumotoro.vegan_detail: Not vegan: omurice, hamburg, seafood, curry.
tokyo_hibiya_matsumotoro.hours_raw: 1F Western grill and garden terrace: daily 11:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:00); closed at New Year (Tabelog). The 3F French restaurant Bois de Boulogne keeps its own hours (listed separately). 1F dinner bookings only; only the terrace open-deck table can be booked by day.
tokyo_hibiya_matsumotoro.notes: [Yōshoku · the restaurant inside Hibiya Park] A long-established Western-food restaurant set in Hibiya Park; this record covers the ground-floor grill and the garden terrace (the third-floor French dining room, Bois de Boulogne, is listed separately). The signature curry is a sweet, fruity, European-style Showa curry. Omurice comes with a choice of sauce and a side such as hamburg, fried shrimp or crab cream croquette. A shrimp and scallop omurice in tomato sauce was ¥1,850; a poulet, cake and coffee set ¥2,800, with seasonal fruit cakes shown at the table. The outdoor terrace is the joy of a fine day (paid special seats exist), and staff seated a party of 12 together. Expect a 30-minute wait at weekends or during park events; only the terrace open-deck table can be booked. Party plans with free-flow are about ¥8,500.

chef_bio.origin: Long-established Hibiya Park restaurant (October 2026 reviews; founding year not given)

anecdotes.text: "The signature curry is a sweet, European-style curry reminiscent of the Showa era. The sweetness from fruits stands out more than the spiciness." — October 2026, party plan.
"Omelette Rice with Shrimp and Scallops in Tomato Sauce JPY 1,850. I visited around noon on Saturday and had to wait about 30 minutes." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日比谷松本楼、千代田区日比谷公園1-2、日比谷駅A14出口・霞ケ関駅B2出口徒歩2分、120席、1階 洋食グリル&ガーデンテラス11:00〜21:00(L.O. 20:00)、3階 フランス料理ボア・ド・ブローニュ(昼11:00〜16:00・夜17:00〜22:00)、年末年始休、サービス料10%(3階のみ)、夜の予約は1階のみ、公式サイト matsumotoro.co.jp。2026年10月の口コミ: 3階のプリフィクス(セップ茸のブランマンジェ、かぼちゃとりんごのポタージュ、オマールのアメリケーヌ)、ウェッジウッドの廃盤の皿、予約できるのはテラスのオープンデッキ1卓のみ、公園のイベントで30分待ち、有料の特別席、屋外席が心地よい、海老と帆立のトマトソースのオムライス1,850円、飲み放題の宴会プラン8,500円、昭和の甘い欧風カレー、プーレとケーキとコーヒーのセット2,800円、オムライスのソースとハンバーグ・エビフライ・かにクリームコロッケを選べる、12人を同じ席に。

tokyo_sushi_sueyoshi_roppongi.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase only, so swaps must be arranged with the chef. Nothing is called gluten-free; the course includes soy-sauce-marinated and shrimp-miso-soy-sauce red shrimp, tuna braised in miso, karasumi wrapped in mochi, and on some days soft-roe spring rolls with house XO sauce (2026 reviews).
tokyo_sushi_sueyoshi_roppongi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an omakase of fish and seafood, with clam broth and shrimp miso soup.
tokyo_sushi_sueyoshi_roppongi.hours_raw: Sushi daily 12:00–14:00 (last order 12:30; lunch only with a reservation made by 17:00 the day before) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 20:30) (Tabelog; official site). The official site lists closing days as irregular. From 22:00 to 04:00 the same counter runs as BAR末吉 (Bar Sueyoshi), with 60-minute all-you-can-drink at ¥3,000 (official site). Omakase courses only; seating 90 minutes, all-you-can-drink 60 minutes; arrive on time; seat-only bookings choose a course on arrival (Tabelog). Bookings by phone or online. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 6 counter seats; non-smoking; private hire up to 20. Opened 3 July 2026 (Tabelog).
tokyo_sushi_sueyoshi_roppongi.notes: [Sushi · Roppongi, a six-seat omakase counter steps from the crossing] Opened in July 2026 on the ground floor a few steps from Roppongi Station exit 5: a single hinoki counter for six, omakase only, at a price unusual for Roppongi (¥8,800, or ¥11,000 with an hour of all-you-can-drink sake). The tuna is fresh domestic hon-maguro from まぐろ大善 at Toyosu, a dealer the shop's site says was founded 400 years ago (reviewers link it to Tokugawa Ieyasu), served as rare cuts like neck, cheek and tail; other fish come straight from fishermen around Japan, and you can watch videos of the buying and the tuna cutting as you eat. A course in autumn 2026 ran about 15 to 17 dishes: Nemuro hokke with fresh wasabi, tuna braised in two misos at the counter, karasumi in grilled mochi, smoked mackerel, red shrimp seared with shrimp-miso soy sauce, grilled eel, anago, tamago and brown-sugar ice cream. Diners in 2026 liked the chef's conversation, and one September party got talking with neighbouring guests; one September regular found the second visit less generous (sea urchin had become a ¥1,100 extra). At 22:00 the room turns into BAR末吉 until 4 am. Lunch only with a booking made the day before.

roles: Head chef (unnamed in the sources read)
chef_bio.background: Per an October 2026 review, the chef spent over five years travelling to fishing ports around Japan and buys local fish direct from trusted fishermen. An October 2026 diner writes that the chef once ran a restaurant in Germany and has also worked as a bartender. The head chef goes to the market in person (October 2026 review). Opened 3 July 2026 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: To share "excitement" and "fun" with guests through omakase sushi; high quality without stiffness, a place where adults can drop in and relax (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Fresh hon-maguro rare cuts from まぐろ大善; tuna braised in miso; karasumi mochi.

anecdotes.text: "The chef has spent over five years traveling to fishing ports across the country, sourcing fresh local fish directly from fishermen." — October 2026, ¥11,000 course with all-you-can-drink.
"The chef has experience running a restaurant in Germany and has also worked as a bartender." — October 2026, ¥15,400 course.
"The sea urchin I had last time now comes with an additional charge of JPY 1,100, and there were no spring rolls or pickles this time." — September 2026, second visit.
"It seems to transform into a bar later in the evening, so if you want to enjoy sushi at a leisurely pace, it's best to visit early." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 鮨末吉 (一部・おまかせ鮨) とBAR末吉 (二部)、同じカウンター。鮨はディナー17:00〜22:00、ランチ12:00〜14:00 (前日17:00までの予約制)、BARは22:00〜28:00、不定休。おまかせコースのみ (滞在約90分): おまかせ鮨8,800円、飲み放題付き11,000円、毛ガニつまみ・うに握り付き飲み放題付き15,400円 (税込)。創業400年の豊洲「まぐろ大善」から国産の生本まぐろを直接仕入れ、赤身から希少部位まで食べ比べ。北海道や長崎・五島などの漁師直送の地魚を江戸前の技で。檜の一枚板カウンター。BARの飲み放題60分3,000円、延長30分1,500円、白州・響・山崎も。六本木3-11-10 ココ六本木ビル1F。Instagram @roppongi_sueyoshi、@barsueyoshi。食べログ (店舗会員): 6席、カウンターのみ、2026年7月3日オープン、毎日12:00〜14:00、17:00〜22:00、カード可、英語のスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Tabelog lists English-speaking staff; omakase only, so there is nothing to order; a 2026 diner thought it would suit overseas visitors.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing and official site; reviews dated through October 2026. Opened 3 July 2026.

tokyo_tsuyano_koku_roppongi.gf_detail: Ask. Nothing is called gluten-free. Sushi with red-vinegar rice and many small dishes; the weekday lunch has an udon set and omurice with demi-glace (May 2026); soy sauce and miso are likely throughout.
tokyo_tsuyano_koku_roppongi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog's listing ticks "vegetarian options" and "particular about vegetables", but no vegan dish is named; the menu is built around fish, sushi and sake snacks, and lunch comes with miso soup.
tokyo_tsuyano_koku_roppongi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri lunch 11:00–14:00 (last order 13:30); every day 17:00–05:00 (food last order 04:00, drinks 04:30) (Tabelog). Lunch had paused and resumed in May 2026 (review). Cover charge ¥1,000 a person; private rooms add a ¥1,000 room fee (¥2,000 in all); karaoke ¥2,000 a person (Tabelog). 50 seats: counter, sofa and box seats, private rooms for 2, 4, 6 or 8; heated-tobacco smoking area (Tabelog; an April 2026 diner notes iQOS is allowed). Cards (incl. UnionPay), IC cards, PayPay and au PAY. Children welcome, with a kids' menu on request (Tabelog). Opened 22 November 2021 (Tabelog).
tokyo_tsuyano_koku_roppongi.notes: [Sake bar · Roppongi, sushi and sake in a basement until 5 am] Down the stairs of a building facing Azabu Police Station, a minute from Roppongi crossing: a back bar lined with sake bottles, a counter, sofas, box seats with what one diner called a nostalgic snack-bar feel, private rooms and karaoke. The draw is the sake list, over 300 labels poured from 90 ml, in tasting flights or all-you-can-drink, served with red-vinegar sushi and small dishes until 5 am. A May 2026 group of three paid about ¥18,000 after a ¥5,000-a-head sake all-you-can-drink of some 30 labels (each guest must order a dish); others come after the last train or simply to stay till the first one. Courses with all-you-can-drink run ¥8,000–¥16,000. On weekdays it serves a cheap lunch: fluffy omurice, an udon set, and a seafood bowl limited to ten. An August 2026 reviewer says it is popular with celebrities and often used by the media for interviews. A ¥1,000 cover applies; English-speaking staff.

chef_bio.background: Opened 22 November 2021 (Tabelog). The shop says English-speaking staff are available and offers sake from 90 ml so beginners can find a sake to suit (Tabelog). A regular mentions the manager seeing guests out (June and July 2025 visits).
chef_bio.philosophy: A sake journey for all the senses — aroma, temperature, aftertaste — for beginners and connoisseurs alike (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Over 300 sakes from 90 ml; red-vinegar sushi; late hours.

anecdotes.text: "It’s open until 5 AM. This is perfect not only for second or third stops during a night out but also for those who want to enjoy a proper meal to wrap up the evening." — April 2026.

"Looking at the menu, I saw they offered an all-you-can-drink course featuring about 30 carefully selected types of Japanese sake… we had to order at least one dish per person." — May 2026; about ¥18,000 for three.
"As a popular spot for celebrities, it’s hard to tell if it’s a bar, sushi restaurant, or supper club." — August 2026.
"The popular fluffy omurice is exquisite, but the limited-quantity seafood rice bowl of the day is not to be missed." — September 2026, lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨×酒×肴 艶ノコク、港区六本木4-9-1 佐竹ビルB1F、六本木駅6番出口から徒歩1分、月〜金11:00〜14:00 (L.O.13:30)、毎日17:00〜翌5:00 (フードL.O.4:00、ドリンクL.O.4:30)、チャージ料お一人様1000円、個室料1000円 (計2000円)、カラオケ1人2000円、50席、個室2・4・6・8名、加熱式たばこ専用の喫煙所、カード・電子マネー・QR可、子ども可、2021年11月22日オープン。日本酒300種以上を90mlから、3種の飲み比べ、飲み放題。赤酢の江戸前鮨。飲み放題付きコース8,000円・10,000円・16,000円。ひとさら: 日本酒ダイニング 艶ノコク、同じ住所と電話番号。口コミ(2026年2月〜9月): 豊洲の魚、ランチ再開 (海鮮ランチ10食1,980円、特製うどん定食1,200円、オムライス1,100円)、トリュフのオムライス1,300円、日本酒飲み放題約30種で1人5,000円、1人1品の注文が必要、Azabu Police Station の向かい、芸能人に人気、朝5時まで。

cultural_comfort.note: The shop says English-speaking staff are available; menu with photos (Tabelog).

tokyo_sushi_hajime_roppongi.gf_detail: Ask. Nothing is called gluten-free. Nigiri are seasoned at the counter (some pieces marinated or brushed with sauce, e.g. swordfish soaked a day in sake and mirin, October 2026), and the starters include squid shumai with ponzu (2026 reviews).
tokyo_sushi_hajime_roppongi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and seafood counter; the course ends with a crustacean miso soup (October 2026).
tokyo_sushi_hajime_roppongi.hours_raw: Sun–Thu and holidays 18:00–01:00 (last order 00:30); Fri–Sat 18:00–03:00 (last order 02:30) (Tabelog). A 10% late-night charge applies after 22:00 (Tabelog). Bookings online; arrival times in 15-minute steps (July 2026 review). 8 seats at an L-shaped counter (Tabelog; July 2026 review); non-smoking. Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (PayPay, Alipay and others) (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Opened 8 August 2024 (Tabelog).
tokyo_sushi_hajime_roppongi.notes: [Sushi · Roppongi, an 8-seat late-night counter on Imoaraisaka] A minute from Roppongi crossing, on the ground floor facing Imoaraisaka: eight seats at an L-shaped counter, open from 18:00 until 1 am, and 3 am at weekends. The young chef, from Saga and previously at Sushi Ryuta in Roppongi, serves an omakase of ten nigiri with sea urchin, two small dishes and miso soup for ¥7,700, or ¥11,000 with 90 minutes of all-you-can-drink sake and wine. The rice blends rice vinegar and red vinegar, the toppings are cut thick and the rice a little generous, on purpose, the chef told an October 2026 diner, because the course has few pieces. Autumn 2026 courses brought Shiogama hon-maguro, kasugo-dai, three sweet shrimp in one piece, grilled sanma, kinmedai and a purple sea-urchin gunkan; a monthly regular adds the Hajime roll of fatty tuna, salmon roe and eel. There is no kitchen, so starters are simple (July 2026). A September 2026 diner counted about half the guests from overseas; others use it as a second stop. A 10% late-night charge applies after 22:00.

chef_bio.chef_name: Kazuya (given name only, per a September 2026 review)
roles: Head chef (September 2026 review: "the head chef, Kazuya")
chef_bio.background: Previously at Sushi Ryuta in Roppongi (Tabelog shop text; October 2026 reviews). Described as a young chef (October 2026 reviews). Opened 8 August 2024; a second-anniversary all-you-can-eat event in August 2026 (review of an invitation event). One regular's July and August 2026 visits mention "the owner" pouring sake and chatting; the sources read do not say whether owner and chef are the same person.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic counter sushi, casual and affordable (Tabelog shop text). With only ten pieces in the course, toppings are cut thicker and the rice made a little larger than traditional Edomae for satisfaction (October 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Ten-piece omakase with sea urchin; the Hajime roll.

anecdotes.text: "Thanks to the charming personality of the head chef, Kazuya, I always have a delightful and delicious experience." — September 2026, third monthly visit, ¥11,000 course.
"I enjoyed the Koeki Kiku sake from Saga Prefecture, which the chef also hails from." — October 2026, value omakase.
"Given its location in Roppongi, the clientele is a mix of foreigners and locals, about half and half." — September 2026, ¥11,000 course.
"The restaurant is quite small, with only 8 seats at an L-shaped counter and no kitchen… The rice is a unique blend of rice vinegar and red vinegar." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨はじめ、港区六本木6-1-5 グッドワークビル1F、日比谷線・大江戸線六本木駅3番出口から約1分、月〜木・日・祝18:00〜翌1:00 (L.O.0:30)、金・土18:00〜翌3:00 (L.O.2:30)、22時以降は10%深夜料金、8席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可、英語メニューと英語を話すスタッフ、2024年8月8日オープン。コース: 握り10貫 (うに入り) と小鉢2品と味噌汁7,700円、日本酒とワインの飲み放題90分付き11,000円、日本酒なしの飲み放題60分付き9,900円。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): Saga 出身の若い大将、六本木の Sushi Ryuta の出身、Imoaraisaka に面した1階、L字カウンター8席で厨房なし、米酢と赤酢のブレンドのシャリ、厚めのネタ、Shiogama の天然本鮪、春子鯛、甘海老3尾、うに軍艦、はじめ巻き、追加の鰯600円・鉄火巻1,100円、客の半分ほどが海外から。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); about half the guests were from overseas on a September 2026 night.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

tokyo_sougo_roppongi.gf_detail: Ask, at least two days ahead: the shop asks for allergies and dietary restrictions two days in advance and adjusts dishes (official site). Nothing is called gluten-free, and 2026 courses included fried spring rolls, corn fritters coated in arare, eggplant with somen, sushi in monaka wafers and a kadaif-topped salad; red miso soup and kombu tsukudani come with the rice.
tokyo_sougo_roppongi.vegan_detail: Shojin (Buddhist vegetarian) cooking. The English site says "Shojin vegetarian… (we can also cater to vegan guests)"; the Japanese site says vegan guests can eat with peace of mind. Say you are vegan when booking (two days ahead). Desserts and drinks include a "cream" zenzai and a ginger latte whose milk is not described; one March 2026 diner wrote that the course had fish, which contradicts the shop's own description.
tokyo_sougo_roppongi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat lunch 11:30–15:00 (last entry 14:00), dinner 17:30–23:00 (last entry 21:30); closed Sundays and public holidays (official site; Tabelog). 10% service charge on courses, food and drinks (official site). Private room for up to 7, room fee ¥5,000; semi-private room for up to 5, ¥2,000 (official site policy page; Tabelog). Cancellation fees apply (course: 100% same day, 50% the day before). Allergies and dietary needs two days ahead. Bookings via TableCheck, Tabelog or phone. 42 seats: 14 at the counter, tables, box seats, private and semi-private rooms; wheelchair access; designated smoking area; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Children welcome. Opened 23 February 2015 (Tabelog; the Japanese chef page also says 2015, the English page 2011). A second shop, 淡路宗胡, is at THE PASONA on Awaji Island (official site).
tokyo_sougo_roppongi.notes: [Shojin · Roppongi, modern Buddhist vegetarian kaiseki from a Daigo-family chef] Owner-chef Daisuke Nomura is the eldest son of the family behind 精進料理 醍醐 in Atago, where the chef was third-generation head chef while it held two Michelin stars from 2008 (official site). In 2015 the chef went independent and opened Sougo a minute from Roppongi Station to bring shojin ryori, the vegetarian cooking of Zen temples, to more people: traditional technique with modern touches and a few surprises, in a relaxed room with a counter, tables and private rooms. Dinner is a kaiseki course (¥15,400 or ¥18,700); lunch can be a ¥1,980 tray of seasonal vegetable dishes, rice and red miso soup, a shojin curry, or a lunch kaiseki. The menu changes about every three weeks; 2026 diners remember sushi in crisp monaka wafers, eggplant 'somen' and fried spring rolls, and you may take home the chopsticks and hand towel. The shop caters to vegans and allergies with two days' notice. A 2026 reviewer found the guests mostly from overseas and felt the staff might not understand much Japanese. Closed Sundays and holidays.

roles: Owner-chef (Tabelog: "Owner Chef Daisuke Nomura"; official site)
chef_bio.origin: Born in Tokyo into the family that runs 精進料理 醍醐 in Atago, eldest son (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the eldest son of the family that runs the shojin restaurant 醍醐 (Daigo) in Atago, Tokyo; built a career as Daigo's third-generation head chef, with two Michelin stars from 2008; went independent in 2015 and opened Shojin 宗胡 (the English page says 2011; Tabelog gives 23 February 2015); teaches and promotes Japanese and shojin cooking in Japan and abroad; named to the Plant Forward Global 50. A second shop, 淡路宗胡, is at THE PASONA, Iwaya, Awaji (official site). A May 2026 diner had heard the restaurant is run by the son of Daigo's owner. Daigo itself is a hidden placeholder in this data (tokyo3_kamiya, name "精進料理 醍醐", address_ja "〒105-0002 東京都港区愛宕2-3-1 201").
chef_bio.philosophy: "I want to cook dishes enjoyable for all guests from every generation, every culture, and every diet… the most memorable dishes are those that give me the opportunity to share moments of gratitude with my guests." (official English chef page).
chef_bio.specialty: Modern shojin kaiseki; sushi in monaka; vegetable sashimi.

anecdotes.text: "I truly appreciate how Sogo accommodates vegans, especially those from abroad. It's also great that they can cater to those with soy milk allergies!" — January 2026.

"I was particularly impressed by the sushi in monaka, where rice and vegetables like avocado are sandwiched together, and the eggplant somen, which creatively uses the eggplant as a vessel for the noodles." — May 2026, Zen course.
"The food was delicious, but it might be better to assume that the staff may not understand much Japanese." — April 2026.
"For my guest, who is used to spicy and oily vegan dishes, the subtlety seemed to come across as bland." — June 2026, dinner with a vegan guest.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (sougo.tokyo): 宗胡 SOUGO、モダンな感性を加えた精進料理を懐石スタイルで、13世紀に禅寺で確立した精進料理、六本木で楽しく美味しく心地よい日本料理を。オーナーシェフ野村大輔は東京愛宕の精進料理醍醐を営む家族の長男、醍醐の三代目料理長、2008年から継続してミシュラン2つ星、2015年に独立して Shojin 宗胡をオープン、精進料理の教育と啓蒙を国内外で、Plant Forward Global 50。お献立: 旬の素材の精進料理、ヴィーガンのお客様にも安心、内容は3週間を目途に入れ替え、アレルギーや食事制限は2日前までに連絡。ディナー17:30〜23:00 (最終入店21:30)、精進懐石 蓮18,700円 (食前酒、料理9品、デザート2品)、禅15,400円 (料理7品、デザート1品)、サービス料10%。ランチ11:30〜15:00 (最終入店14:00)、二段重弁当 (1日10食) 6,600円、お昼の御膳1,980円、shojinカレーセット1,980円、お昼懐石13,200円。お持ち帰り: 宗胡弁当2,500円、真寿箱4,000円。六本木6-1-8 六本木グリーンビル3F、日曜・祝日休み、個室 (7名、室料5,000円)、半個室 (5名、2,000円)。淡路宗胡: 兵庫県淡路市岩屋 THE PASONA 2F。食べログ: 42席、2015年2月23日オープン。口コミ(2026年1月〜8月): お昼の御膳1,980円、サラダ・デザート・ドリンク付き3,080円、カダイフのサラダ、筍ご飯、胡麻豆腐の揚げ物、もなかの寿司、茄子そうめん、箸とおしぼりを持ち帰れる、海外の客が多い、ヴィーガンや豆乳アレルギーにも対応。

cultural_comfort.note: Official site in English, Chinese and Korean; a 2026 diner found the staff and menu geared to overseas guests.

vegan_cross_contact.text: English site: "Shojin vegetarian… (we can also cater to vegan guests)"; Japanese site: vegan guests can eat with peace of mind.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Official site: "Please inform us of any allergies or dietary restrictions at least two days in advance… so that we can prepare variety of dishes accommodating to your request."
Diners with allergies had dishes swapped on advance notice (March 2024 visit) and a soy-milk allergy accommodated (January 2026).
